description: Remake layer: where the Nintendo Switch remake differs from the base OoT world. Each rule replaces the base rule of the location; each move puts a location in another region. Found in game or by the audit (python -m oot_rando audit).

Links Pocket.why: The base world hands the Link's Pocket reward out at the start; the remake gives it through Rauru only after the first Master Sword pull (11/10: an Ocarina placed there was counted in sphere 0).

LW Gift from Saria.why: Saria's bridge gift is only proven after the Deku Tree (the only vanilla way out of the forest); with the forest opened early the cutscene trigger is not validated in game.

LW Near Shortcuts Grotto Chest.why: The only Lost Woods chest (purple rupee) is not in a grotto: it stands on a ledge of the stick-scrub room that only the adult bean platform of the soil near the bridge reaches (Obj_SmallFarm_A_03 → DestinationAnchor at 2.9 m).

Song from Saria.rule: is_child and Zeldas_Letter and at('GC Darunias Chamber', is_child)
Song from Saria.why: Saria teaches her song during the Fire Stone quest (Challenge Get_StoneOfFire, step SariaMelodyGet), only after Darunia asked for music in his chamber (11/11: Kokiri Sword behind the Skull Kid).

LW Near Shortcuts Grotto Chest.why: Same chest: on a ledge of the Lost Woods, not in the grotto.
